extraction_policy.excluded: lib/tests/ and test fixtures, e2e/ scripts, scripts/ dev tooling, frontend/ and component-lib/ (JavaScript), generated proto code, the nested streamlit-db database directory, setup.py
extraction_policy.noise_controls: pure existence checks (os.path.exists/isdir/isfile) and path-construction nodes (os.path.join/abspath/basename/normpath/realpath, pathlib.Path()) are not extracted as sinks; only actual filesystem operations are; request sources are restricted to observed tornado request idioms and the repo's upload boundary

database_content_and_path_format.path_format_note: Database file paths are stored forward-slash normalized (src.zip entries like 'C_/Users/.../streamlit_vuln/lib/streamlit/server/routes.py'), while the sourceLocationPrefix in codeql-database.yml uses backslashes ('C:\\Users\\...\\streamlit_vuln'). File.getRelativePath() may therefore be unable to resolve on this Windows-created database (prefix/suffix separator mismatch in its implementation). The extraction queries use a fallback that captures the 'lib/streamlit/...' suffix from getAbsolutePath(), so the 'lib/streamlit/%' scope filter holds regardless of which form resolves. getRelativePath() results are additionally backslash-normalized before matching.
